summary: Candidate is a knowledge_reference layer that provides canonical API documentation for D3 selection and event handling. Peer candidate e352cfb4 (D3 Data Binding and Selection Join) is a session_skill that operationalizes data binding workflows. The candidate strengthens the reference foundation for that workflow by providing lookup documentation for the underlying APIs (selection.data, selection.join, selection.enter/update/exit, event binding). This is a classic reference-to-workflow support relationship across asset layers. The candidate should be preserved as a knowledge_reference that supports the existing session_skill, not merged or discarded.
